title: 10% coupon charges $0.00
trap: The discount function is shared with wholesale bulk pricing, which must also come out right.
issue: A customer with a $50.00 cart used the `SAVE10` coupon (10% off) and the receipt said `Total charged: $0.00`. It should be $48.60 ($50 - 10% = $45, plus 8% tax). Without a coupon the total is correct.
